about_the_game:
This is in a dreamlike fantasy world. "Days with girlfriends : Laler&Reese" starts a warm and surprising adventure.

Welcome to Ansano Haven Village. Before that, you need to abide by the following rules:

Men and women must sign the terms of the contract and be responsible for each other when they cooperate;

Unconditionally believe in, respect, and love the goddess Laleel;

Do not leave the village without a pass;

You can now start a new life in this beautiful village

Game Features

Elimination and unlock: Unlock exquisite illustrations by eliminating three blocks, bringing visual enjoyment.

Multiple heroines: three female characters with different personalities

18 exquisite illustrations: exquisite illustrations, presenting moving moments.

One-click skip: fast forward, skip repeated content, and play easily.

Role introduction

Name: Laleel, the holy goddess with a heart

The holy goddess, meticulous, perfectionist.

Has an unknown dark side, with a clear sense of contrast.

Name: Reese "Master Laleer is right!"

A lively and sunny little believer, simple and brainless

Name: Shirley Field "Goddess, times have changed"

A righteous and generous female hunter, a straightforward lady.

Rebellious, yearning for freedom, refusing responsibility, an atheist

short_description: This is a classic match-3 game that combines fun, challenge and romance. You need to complete various tasks and challenges by eliminating the same gems! Quickly connect them to eliminate them! Every time you successfully pass a level, you will be rewarded with exquisite and beautiful illustrations.
supported_languages: English, Simplified Chinese, Russian, Japanese, Traditional Chinese, Korean
